open_items: Fire diagnosis. Compared 2 b5-d1898555 kills (k2-20260924T025034Z, k1-20260924T031933Z) with all 3 r01 kills. Round 1 Fire is 8-11k DPS below the b5 mages. Two causes, and neither is a regression in the Magmaw strategy files.

(1) Combustion, about -6.7k DPS, class-owned. Combustion 83853 dealt 431-469k per r01 kill against 0.94-1.43M on b5, 4.4-5.1k DPS against 9.7-14.7k. Ignite at the Combustion cast was 27-30k on r01 and 62-69k on b5. The cast fires as soon as the class gate passes (Ignite >= 10k, Living Bomb and a Pyroblast DoT; BotWorldPopulationMgrCombatResolverAdmission.cpp). That gate is byte-identical at 39132c1b4c (b5) and HEAD. Fireball, Pyroblast! and Living Bomb hit sizes match, and crit matches (46-47%), so this is Combustion timing, not gear or buffs. It belongs to the class agent. Another packet currently has an uncommitted Combustion-related edit in BotWorldPopulationMgrCombatResolverAdmission.cpp and BotRaidRotationOverrides.h.

(2) Bait load, about -4.1k DPS, caused by the roster change. Without Combustion, Fire does 35.0-37.5k on b5 and 29.1-34.0k on r01. On b5 the DPS-064 rotation gave each of the two Fire Mages one parasite wave. The canonical roster has one Fire Mage, so it baits both waves (baiter_rotation reason single_mage, duty plan bait_mage 11000004). During a bait wave the baiter deals 18-35k (boss plus parasites), against about 37k for a non-baiting mage on b5.

No owned C++ change was made. Taking the single mage off alternate waves (a hunter-only wave) needs a vacant-mage-slot mode in BotMagmawLaneTransition.h. HasAssignedBaiters and IsArrived require both slots, and AssignBaiters ignores an empty mage. The hook-rider list must also stay stable, because a free Fire Mage (lowest-GUID DPS 11000004) would become hook rider 1 in place of Ret/Rogue. Either change can alter parasite handling and deaths, and there is no second Blink-capable spec in the roster. It needs an implementation, an independent review and a 5-kill batch; it is too large and unverifiable to land blind in this round. Estimated gain: about half of the 4.1k bait delta.

Head-phase uptime and Lava Spew are not factors. Every retained kill ended 0-10 s after the first Mangle (about 90 s), before any head exposure. Fire's moving fraction is similar on b5 (0.19-0.27) and r01 (0.21-0.23).

Demonology Warlock at 86% (class evidence only). Parasite damage is small (about 31k per kill) and the moving fraction is 0.07-0.08, so no Magmaw duty burdens it. The damage uptime (0.70-0.83) and cast rate (35-41 CPM) gaps are rotation-owned.

Sweltering Armor apply anchor: no code change needed. The native script has applied 78199 at Mangle release since a5c6606d93 (2026-09-23), in the PassengerBoarded seat-exit branch, for a living, in-combat target only. The sources of both b5 (39132c1b4c) and r01 (553da85c98) contain it, and tests/test_magmaw_mangle_sweltering_release.py covers it. The round-1 'boarding' conflict described the older source. The contract, ledger and dossier are corrected; status values and the unresolved count (8) are unchanged. The scoreboard evidence retains no aura-apply timestamp, so there is no live readback.
encounter_research stays fidelity_blocked (same gating question as the round-1 patch request to raid_program_inputs.py).
18 Magmaw focused tests fail before and after these edits (down from 28 in round 1); see tests.

patch_requests.patch: Append to the DPS-064 detail row (line ~67, after 'Baiter alternation was not needed.'): ' Round 2 (2026-09-27): on the canonical roster (one Fire Mage, r01 blackwing_descent_10n-r01-553da85c98) the rotation falls back to single_mage, so the only Fire Mage baits both waves: non-Combustion DPS 29.1-34.0k against 35.0-37.5k on b5 (about -4.1k). A hunter-only alternate wave needs a vacant-mage-slot mode in BotMagmawLaneTransition.h (HasAssignedBaiters/IsArrived require both) plus a stable hook-rider list; not yet implemented.' and add an open row: '| DPS-070 | open | Fire Mage (canonical BWD roster) | Combustion 83853 casts at the first gate pass (Ignite >= 10k) with 27-30k Ignite; 431-469k per kill against 0.94-1.43M on b5-d1898555 (about -6.7k DPS) | Class owner: wait for a larger Ignite (for example after a Pyroblast!/Fireball crit roll) within the cooldown budget |'.

Class agent (Fire Mage), evidence only: on r01 every Magmaw Combustion 83853 fired with Ignite 27-30k (combustion_dot_window_not_ready passes at >= 10000), total 431-469k per kill. On b5-d1898555 it fired with 62-69k Ignite, totalling 0.94-1.43M. Fire's gap to 95% WCL is 1.8k DPS; Combustion alone is about 6.7k. Keep any change raid-scoped so the b5-d1898555 Magmaw mages (30006/30007), Stonecore and calibration stay reproducible.
